# Fixture: ccxxmake 生成 CCMX 校正矩阵成功
# 来源: 手写，基于 ArgyllCMS ccxxmake 成功输出
# 工具版本: ArgyllCMS v2.2.x / v3.x
# 命令: ccxxmake -v -t l -y l -z l -Y n -f ref.ti3,target.ti3 output.ccmx

# ========== 启动阶段 ==========
ArgyllCMS ccxxmake - Correction matrix creator
Version 2.2.1

Target display type: LCD (l)
Reference instrument mode: LCD
Target instrument mode: LCD
Refresh mode: Non-refresh (LCD/OLED)

# ========== 输入文件处理 ==========
Reference (spectro) TI3: ref.ti3
Target (colorimeter) TI3: target.ti3

Reading reference measurements ...
Loaded 100 patches from ref.ti3

Reading target measurements ...
Loaded 100 patches from target.ti3

# ========== 矩阵计算 ==========
Computing correction matrix ...
Matrix type: CCMX (Matrix)

# ========== 交互确认 ==========
# ccxxmake 会询问是否清除缓存
# argyll_controller.py 使用延迟注入 'y' 线程自动回答

Clear existing matrix cache? (y/n)

# ========== 完成输出 ==========
Created correction matrix 'output.ccmx'

Matrix values:
X = 0.9876 * R + 0.0234 * G + -0.0110 * B
Y = 0.0012 * R + 1.0123 * G + -0.0135 * B
Z = -0.0056 * R + 0.0089 * G + 1.0067 * B

Matrix accuracy: RMS error = 0.0034 DeltaE

# ========== 预期解析结果 ==========
# 成功检测:
# - "Created correction matrix" + ".ccmx" -> 文件已生成
# - 返回码 = 0
# - 文件存在: output.ccmx

# CCMX 文件解析:
# - MATRIX_XYZ_XYZ 行 -> 矩阵系数
# - MATRIX_ESUM 行 -> 误差摘要

# ========== argyll_controller.py 特殊处理 ==========
# ccxxmake 有交互式"清空缓存"提示，需要延迟注入 'y'
# make_ccmx() 方法使用 threading.Thread 自动应答
